name: gary-ai-platform-monitor
description: macOS menu bar app that discovers local AI platform logins, monitors usage quotas as percentages, and shows official status-page health.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/core && npm run build -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/health && npm run build -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/adapter-claude && npm run build -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/adapter-codex && npm run build -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/adapter-grok && npm run build -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/runtime && npm run build -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/cli && npm run build -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/menubar
scripts.snapshot: npm run build -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/runtime && npm run build -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/cli && node apps/cli/dist/cli.js snapshot
scripts.app: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && npm run start -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/menubar
scripts.test: npm run test -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/core --if-present && npm run test -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/health --if-present && npm run test -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/adapter-claude --if-present && npm run test -w @gary-ai-platform-monitor/adapter-codex --if-present
